title: Ardgillan Castle
scope: Ardgillan Castle’s castellated country house, attached service ranges and open courts, and the Victorian conservatory in the rose garden.
limitations: Standing country house and service ranges with the rose garden conservatory. The remote park outbuildings, garden planting, icehouse and interiors are outside the modeled footprint.

Roof heights, proportions of minor rear openings and the exact grey render finish are approximate. The 13-bay frontage and slate roof concealed by battlements follow the national inventory and photographs.
The conservatory uses its named footprint and the original photograph. Minor glazing divisions and the foundation bench are estimated.
